decision: Deliver Choros E0.6 as: (a) one `choros` service block added to repo-root `docker-compose.yml` (additive, all three existing service blocks untouched), built from a multi-stage Dockerfile (web-builder→app-builder→runtime on node:20-slim); env vars with dev-only defaults; depends_on postgres/keycloak/flowable (service_healthy); host port ${APP_PORT:-3000}:3000; (b) `docker-compose.prod.yml` override using required-form `${VAR}` (no :-default) for all sensitive vars, KC command switched to `start` (prod mode), volumes renamed with `_prod` suffix, NODE_ENV=production; (c) `.env.prod.example` committed with REPLACE_* placeholder values only (RL-3); (d) `.gitignore` extended with `.env.prod`; (e) `ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh` covering static fitness for AC-1..AC-12. Mechanism: compose override-files (base=dev defaults, override=prod required-form) — the standard single-artifact mode-as-config pattern (tenancy ADR §7). No src/ files touched (T-0068 owns index.ts concurrently). Migrations run in-process via existing `migrations/run.mjs` (silo-upgrade semantic, tenancy ADR §5). KC full prod hardening (TLS, KC_PROXY=edge, KC_HOSTNAME_URL) deferred to E0.7 (honest gap, founder-gated).

rejected_alternatives.why_not: Profile syntax is less visible than a dedicated override file; the two-file merge model is the documented standard for dev/prod parity; profiles do not naturally enforce required-form variables without additional tooling. Override-files is the compose canonical mechanism for mode-as-config.

Requires duplicating all three existing service blocks (postgres/kc/flowable) into both files; violates DRY and makes future additive changes require two edits per service. The base+override model keeps each service edited once.
Contradicts one-artifact mode-as-config (tenancy ADR §7); doubles Dockerfile maintenance surface; the same image with different env vars is standard and sufficient.

rejected_alternatives.option: External migration step / init-container in compose
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Adds compose orchestration complexity (condition: service_completed_successfully hacks or wrapper scripts); the existing migrations/run.mjs runner is already called in-process from server.ts when DATABASE_URL is set; the silo-upgrade semantic (tenancy ADR §5) maps directly to migrate-then-serve.

rejected_alternatives.option: H2 for KC internal store in dev, Postgres in prod
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Already decided in T-0054 §1.1: KC uses the shared Postgres instance (single-substrate principle). Switching to H2 for dev would violate mode=config invariant and require a second KC store-mode override in the prod file.

contracts: docker-compose.yml choros service: build='.', environment with dev defaults (${VAR:-dev_value}), depends_on postgres+keycloak+flowable (condition: service_healthy), ports ['${APP_PORT:-3000}:3000'], healthcheck on /health or TCP:3000.

docker-compose.prod.yml: ALL sensitive vars (PASSWORD, SECRET, KEY, TOKEN) in ${VAR} form (no :-default); keycloak.command='start --import-realm' (not start-dev); NODE_ENV=production for choros; volumes with _prod suffix; no new Postgres service (NF-3 single-instance invariant).

Dockerfile: 3-stage build (web-builder node:20-alpine, app-builder node:20-alpine, runtime node:20-slim); EXPOSE 3000; CMD ['node','dist/index.js']; migrations/ included in runtime stage (silo-upgrade semantic); no .env* baked in.
.dockerignore: excludes node_modules, dist, .env*, .git, ci, docs, spikes, .claude, web/node_modules; does NOT exclude web/src/ or migrations/.
.env.prod.example: committed to repo; every sensitive value contains 'REPLACE'; copy-and-fill instructions inline; no real credential.
.gitignore: contains .env.prod (exact or pattern .env.); also .env.*.local if absent.

ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh: set -euo pipefail; PASS/FAIL stdout; exit 0 on all-green, exit 1 on first failure; covers FF-T61-1..FF-T61-10 statically (no Docker daemon required for grep/yaml checks; docker compose config -q needs compose CLI).
No src/ files modified (T-0068 owns index.ts concurrently — strict non-interference).

docs/environments.md: new §7 table listing choros-app env vars (DATABASE_URL, CHOROS_AUTH_MODE, PORT, APP_PORT, NODE_ENV, KC_ISSUER, KEYCLOAK_PORT, KEYCLOAK_REALM) with dev defaults and prod required notes.
npm run fitness: compose-prod-config.sh added to the fitness script chain in package.json.

fitness_functions.rule: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config -q exits 0 without any .env file (dev mode, all defaults present).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 1: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml config -q; non-zero exit → FAIL. (AC-1)

fitness_functions.rule: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml config -q exits 0 when all required vars provided via --env-file with placeholder-replaced values.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 2: create temp env file from .env.prod.example with sed replacing REPLACE_* with dummy non-empty strings; docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file $tmp config -q; non-zero exit → FAIL. (AC-2)

fitness_functions.rule: docker-compose.prod.yml must NOT contain ${VAR:-default} form for PASSWORD, SECRET, TOKEN, KEY variables — only ${VAR} (required form).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 3: grep -E '(PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN|KEY).*:-' docker-compose.prod.yml; any match → FAIL; zero matches → PASS. (AC-3)

fitness_functions.rule: Prod overlay volumes use _prod suffix; dev volume name choros_pgdata does not appear bare in the prod overlay.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 4: grep 'choros_pgdata:' docker-compose.prod.yml | grep -v _prod → FAIL if match; grep 'choros_pgdata_prod' docker-compose.prod.yml → FAIL if absent. (AC-4)

fitness_functions.rule: .env.prod.example exists and every sensitive value line (PASSWORD/SECRET/KEY/TOKEN) contains REPLACE or is empty.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 5: [[ -f .env.prod.example ]] || FAIL; grep -iE '(PASSWORD|SECRET|KEY|TOKEN)=' .env.prod.example | grep -vE '(REPLACE|=\s*$)' → FAIL if match. (AC-5)
ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 6: grep -E '^\.env\.prod$|^\.env\.' .gitignore → FAIL if no match. (AC-6)

fitness_functions.rule: docker-compose.yml has a choros service with build, depends_on (postgres+keycloak+flowable), port 3000.
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 7: grep 'choros:' docker-compose.yml → FAIL if absent; grep 'depends_on' after choros block includes postgres, keycloak, flowable; grep '3000' in ports section. (AC-7)

fitness_functions.rule: Dockerfile exists in repo root. Full docker build is gated in CI (docker build -t choros-ci-test .) exits 0.
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static (compose-prod-config.sh): [[ -f Dockerfile ]] || FAIL. CI build step (ci.yml): docker build -t choros-ci-test . exits 0. (AC-8)
ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 9: grep 'start-dev' docker-compose.prod.yml → FAIL if match; grep 'command:.*start' docker-compose.prod.yml → FAIL if absent. (AC-9)

fitness_functions.rule: All host port defaults in docker-compose.yml are unique (no two services share same default host port).
fitness_functions.ci_check: ci/checks/compose-prod-config.sh step 10: extract all :- port defaults from port mappings; assert set is unique; assert 3000 not in {55432,8180,9000,8082}. (AC-11)

fitness_functions.rule: ci/checks/no-committed-secret.sh continues to exit 0 after T-0061 changes (no unexpected password literal in new files).
fitness_functions.ci_check: npm run fitness (already includes no-committed-secret.sh); new choros service in docker-compose.yml uses only allowed dev defaults (choros_dev_pw is in ALLOWED_DEV_DEFAULTS); docker-compose.prod.yml has no literal passwords. (AC-12)

fitness_functions.rule: docker compose up -d brings all 4 services (postgres, keycloak, flowable, choros) to healthy/running state without manual intervention.
fitness_functions.ci_check: CI integration job: docker compose up -d --wait; docker compose ps shows all 4 services healthy. Extends existing integration job that already covers KC+flowable smokes. (AC-13)
